description:
With the method-2 baseline merged (270 ms total, floors 5 ms and 31 ms), the dispatched nightly run 44386073922 on develop compared for real and reported a regression: total 320 ms (+18.6%, +50 ms), EPYC 7763 at about 3.0 GHz, DuckDB 2.0.0, host load normal. Per-query slowdowns up to +46%, mostly on queries of 3-5 ms. The two EPYC 7763 source nights of 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13 ran 275-276 ms, and all five sources ran 261-286 ms, so tonight is 12% above the slowest source.

Decide whether it is a real slowdown or runner noise: compare the next two scheduled nightly results (t3-perf-result artifacts), then bisect develop commits since 2026-11-16 touching DuckDB, TPC-H or timing code if it repeats. If it is noise, widen the aggregate floor from a larger sample under the documented rule; never loosen it without data.
